run_text_server: run the MCP text tools server using FastMCP with text manipulation tools
reverse_text: reverse the characters in a string using the reverse_text MCP tool
count_words: count the number of words in a string using the count_words MCP tool
to_uppercase: convert a string to uppercase using the to_uppercase MCP tool
format_text: generate a prompt for formatting text in a specified style using format_text
